visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Aliasing and Copying Lists
visualizerParams.description: Assigning a list to another name does not copy it. copy() makes a shallow copy (inner lists are still shared), and a comprehension that copies each row makes a deeper copy.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
original = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
alias = original
shallow = original.copy()
deep = [row[:] for row in original]
original[0][0] = 99
print(alias[0][0], shallow[0][0], deep[0][0])
original.append([5, 6])
print(len(alias), len(shallow), len(deep))
